title: Report a rejected local read
prompt: Call the supplied source once. Resolve with {kind:"loaded", items} when it returns a string array, including an empty array. Resolve with {kind:"failed"} if it rejects for any reason.
hints: A fulfilled empty array still counts as a loaded batch.
Wait for the reader inside a try block.
Build different tagged results for fulfillment and rejection.
checks: await (async()=>{let calls=0; await loadBatch(async()=>{calls++;return []}); return calls===1;})()

wrongAnswers.misconception: Treats rejection as an empty success.

feedback: A fulfilled empty array still counts as a loaded batch.
